messages:
clare: Aurorix Systems asks for a compact reproducible bench for joint perf/W and kernel tuning. They want a one-page cert for marketplace and CSV output. @hiro @pavel can you sketch the minimal sweep and telemetry?
hiro: Minimal sweep: models=redwood-3b + redwood-13b, seqs=512/2048, powercaps=80/120/160W, quants=q4_0 + int8. Capture throughput_tps, p50/p95/p99 latency, avg_power_w@10Hz, joules_per_token. Also record thermal_throttle_events and nvlink_util_percent.
pavel: We'll sample perf counters (instructions, cycles, llc_misses) via perf + PMU. Lab slot Thu 14:00-17:00 PT looks free. Partner provided driver flags and a signed firmware blob (fw-aurorix-v2.0). They want acceptance criteria: perf/W >= baseline+11% at 120W OR p99 < 230ms at seq=2048.
clare: Good. Include exact CSV schema and a reproducible script. Telemetry ingestion URL is https://telemetry.redwood.dev/ingest (X-API-KEY). Partner asked to avoid any config that requires rebooting the FPGA during runs.
hiro: Example boot flags and run command below:
```
# kernel boot flags
mitigations=off isolcpus=8-15 nohz_full=8-15 rcu_nocbs=8-15
# run example
./bench_harness --model redwood-13b --seq 2048 --batch 2 --quant q4_0 --powercap 120 --out s3://redwood-bench/aurorix/1798001234/ 
```
pavel: Dataset: 800 curated prompts at /data/bench/aurorix/800.jsonl.gz. I'll stage with sha256 checksums. We'll tag runs with "aurorix-2026-cert". Ops-bot: please reserve bench and verify rack meters.
ops-bot: Bench slot reserved Thu 2026-03-25 14:00-17:00 PT. Reminder: attach firmware sha256 and driver version in run metadata.
clare: CSV header suggestion: [run_id,model,seq,powercap,quant,batch,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tps,avg_power_w, joules_per_token,thermal_throttle_events,nvlink_util_pct,firmware_sha256]. Add a short explanation for each field in the runbook.
hiro: I'll write the runbook and include Grafana dashboard links and alert thresholds. Will also include a small sanity smoke: 50 prompts before full sweep.
pavel: I'll prepare perf scripts and PMU collection. Also plan to compute per-batch energy = avg_power_w * run_duration_s and derive joules_per_token.
bench-bot: JIRA INF-10022 created, assignee=@hiro, label=aurorix-cert. Tag experiments with "aurorix-2026-mar". Remember to anonymize client inputs for marketplace CSV.
clare: Action items: Hiro -> runbook + scripts + push to bench/aurorix branch; Pavel -> PMU scripts + dataset + checksums; Ops -> verify meters + bench prep; I'll draft partner-facing one-pager and schedule Fri 10am PT sync. If smoke passes, proceed to full sweep.
hiro: Ack. Will push runbook draft and a short checklist (smoke pass criteria: no thermal throttle, checksum match, p50 within 10% of baseline).
pavel: Ack. Will smoke tonight and upload artifacts.
clare: Thanks everyone. I'll loop the Aurorix PM and Legal for marketplace wording after we have CSV example. :thumbsup:
